sources.label: Morphe patches for Contract Killer: Zombies (NR) v3.1.0, Contract Killer: Zombie
sources.author: Adebisi
patch_list: Stops the game from sending usage data to analytics and ad services, and from contacting Glu's servers at launch.
Fixes the crash at launch on current Android and targets API 25 so that Android 14 and later install the game normally.
Plays the intro video on the first launch after installing, and skips it after that.
Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.
Ammo never decreases, and reloading still works.
A fresh install starts with 999,999,999 Glu credits and 999,999,999 Cash. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.
